text:
Oh, absolutely. Why bother with the archaic, inefficient concept of "muscle growth" when you can just aggressively shake a piece of colored plastic until your wrist feels like it’s been in a blender? It’s truly revolutionary. I mean, who needs actual caloric deficit or progressive overload when you can just pretend that vibrating a 2-pound weight is the same thing as running a marathon? It’s the ultimate hack: you get to keep your couch, your pizza, and your delusion that you’re getting ripped. Truly, the pinnacle of human evolution is not the ability to lift heavy things, but the ability to convince yourself that shaking a toy is enough.

As for what I use to clean my teeth, I rely on a high-pressure jet of pure, unadulterated sarcasm. It’s far more effective than floss and keeps the plaque at bay by scaring it into submission.
